commercialUse.false: The publisher, or the terms of a training dataset that the publisher names, limits use to non-commercial or research purposes. This takes precedence over the other rules.
commercialUse.true: The weights carry a declared license that permits commercial use and no named training dataset restricts commercial use. Undisclosed training data alone does not downgrade the result.
commercialUse.unknown: Otherwise, in particular when no license is declared for the weights. The plugin shows the same pre-download notice as for false (decision D11).

distribution.mirror: The reviewed members are repacked into a content-addressed archive on the speech-models-vN release; the upstream asset is the fallback.
distribution.upstream-only: No archive is published (catalog mirror null); clients install the listed files from the pinned sherpa-onnx release asset and verify them file by file. Used when the maintainer decides not to redistribute weights.

licenseRefs.LicenseRef-FunASR-Model-License-1.1: FunASR Model Open Source License Agreement 1.1 (https://github.com/modelscope/FunASR/blob/main/MODEL_LICENSE).
licenseRefs.LicenseRef-NoLicenseDeclared: The upstream publisher declares no license for these weights. The catalog either mirrors the exact public sherpa-onnx release asset or, when the maintainer decides not to redistribute, lists it as upstream-only.
